name: Remote Viewing
description: A claimed psychic ability to perceive distant or unseen targets, studied in U.S. government-funded research programmes from 1972 to 1995 and concluded by independent review to lack reliable evidence.

aliases.name: Coordinate Remote Viewing (CRV)
aliases.meaning: Ingo Swann's structured protocol used at SRI

aliases.name: Extended Remote Viewing (ERV)
aliases.meaning: Variant developed within the U.S. Army programmes

aliases.name: Stargate Project
aliases.meaning: Umbrella name for the U.S. government remote-viewing programmes from 1991

aliases.name: Sun Streak / Center Lane / Grill Flame / Gondola Wish
aliases.meaning: Earlier classified codenames for the same lineage of programmes

origin: Research has been conducted primarily in the United States, with related parapsychological work in the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, the former Soviet Union, and elsewhere. Government interest is documented for the United States and (in declassified records) for the Soviet Union.
